{"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR issue. The supplied text supports completing WP-19 on the Email+LINE capability-statement branch, with one caveat: the "server rejects SMS" claim is only partly evidenced.

- **SMS is never presented as usable.** The form shows it as a disabled option labelled "尚未串接，不能啟用". The list, new and edit page headers each say SMS is not connected. The Zod channel enum is `["email","line"]`, and a unit test asserts `sms` is rejected.
- **The docs match the branch.** The WP-19 doc marks EVERY8D, pricing, metering, opt-out and Sandbox delivery as NOT_RUN and leaves READY to canonical acceptance. The provider-research doc records "先不實作". No billing, schema or provider changes appear in the supplied text.
- **Requiring the SMS branch's Sandbox, opt-out and point-record evidence would be wrong here.**

The findings below are residual inconsistencies and evidence gaps. None of them is a blocker, but the first one is worth fixing before READY because the WP's stated purpose is a consistent UI/docs capability statement.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Template list empty-state copy (capability consistency)","file":"src/app/(app)/messages/templates/page.tsx","issue":"The empty state says to create Email templates first and that "其餘渠道會在事件來源或 provider 完成後才開放". This contradicts the PageHeader on the same page, the new/edit pages and the WP-19 doc, which all say Email and LINE are both selectable.","evidence":"EmptyState description: "先建立報名成功、開播提醒或課後通知 Email；其餘渠道會在事件來源或 provider 完成後才開放。" PageHeader: "可選 Email 或 LINE 建立通知模板…SMS 尚未串接。" The page test only asserts the header text and the absence of the old "SMS、LINE 在事件來源或 provider 接通前保持停用" string. It never asserts the empty-state text.","impact":"Merchants with no templates are told LINE is not yet open. This understates a capability and splits the capability statement WP-19 was meant to make consistent. It does not overclaim SMS.","recommended_fix":"Reword the empty state to match the header, for example: create an Email or LINE template, and say SMS is not connected. Add the empty-state text to the page test.","required_test":"Render the unfiltered empty state. Assert it mentions both Email and LINE and contains "SMS 尚未串接". Assert it does not say the other channels open later.","confidence":0.85},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Legacy or unknown channel rendering in list","file":"src/app/(app)/messages/templates/page.tsx","issue":"`channelLabel` returns the raw stored value for any channel other than email or line. A pre-existing `sms` row would show a blue "sms" badge next to a green "模板啟用" badge, with no "unavailable" marker. The test fixtures cover an unknown trigger but no unknown channel.","evidence":"`function channelLabel(value){ if(value==="email")…; if(value==="line")…; return value; }`. The test row "legacy_trigger" uses channel "email". The validator now rejects SMS, so any existing row could not be re-saved without changing its channel. I did not see whether such rows exist.","impact":"If legacy SMS rows exist, the list could read as if an active SMS template is operating. The WP doc's disclaimer that "模板啟用" is not delivery evidence is not shown in that row.","recommended_fix":"Map `sms` to a label such as "SMS（尚未串接）" and map other unknown values to "未知通道". Optionally show a disabled-style badge for non-email, non-LINE channels.","required_test":"Render a template with channel "sms" and an unknown channel. Assert the unavailable or unknown label is shown and the raw value is not presented as an active channel.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Server-side SMS rejection evidence","file":"src/lib/message-template.test.ts","issue":"The "server-side SMS rejection" claim rests on a unit test of `normalizeMessageTemplateDraft`. The `upsertTemplateAction` that uses it is not in the supplied text. That function is what actually enforces the rejection at the server boundary.","evidence":"The test `it.each(["sms"]) rejects the unconnected %s channel` calls only `normalizeMessageTemplateDraft`. `@/app/actions` is mocked in the form test. The action body, including whether it validates before any DB write, is not supplied.","impact":"From the supplied text alone, a path that bypasses the validator cannot be ruled out. The completion statement is slightly stronger than the evidence I can see.","recommended_fix":"In the evidence package, cite the action-level test or the exact code line showing `upsertTemplateAction` calls `normalizeMessageTemplateDraft` before any persistence. Add that test if it is missing.","required_test":"Call `upsertTemplateAction` with channel=sms for both create and update. Assert it returns `invalid_template` and that no `messageTemplate` create or update is called.","confidence":0.55},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Server vs UI trigger/channel combinations","file":"src/lib/message-template.ts","issue":"The server validator only restricts LINE to the three webinar triggers. It accepts email with `live_started`, `order_created`, `order_paid` and `commission_credited`. The UI and the WP doc present Email as only registration, reminder and post-live follow-up.","evidence":"`normalizeMessageTemplateDraft` rejects only `channel==="line"` with a trigger outside `LINE_WEBINAR_TEMPLATE_TRIGGERS`. The form disables `live_started` for email. The WP doc lists the Email triggers as registration_confirmed, live_reminder and post_live_followup.","impact":"A crafted request can save an Email template for a trigger the product does not send. That is a minor mismatch with the capability statement, not an SMS claim. The WP doc's "表單／伺服器行為一致" holds for SMS only.","recommended_fix":"Either narrow the doc wording to say "SMS rejected consistently", or add a server-side Email trigger allowlist. Handle this in a follow-up if it is out of scope for this pass.","required_test":"Assert that normalize rejects (or deliberately accepts, with a documented reason) email+live_started and email+order_paid.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Unsupplied source behind LINE capability claims","file":"docs/launch/wp19-notification-channels-20261016.md","issue":"The doc says LINE supports registration confirmation, live reminder and live start, and cites `src/lib/line-notification-materializer.ts`. It also says evidence lives in a "本 WP evidence 與 handoff". Neither is in the supplied text.","evidence":"The doc's "來源" section lists the materializer file and an unsupplied evidence or handoff. The supplied code only shows the LINE trigger allowlist in the validator.","impact":"I could confirm that LINE templates can be created for those triggers. I could not confirm the materializer sends for them. The doc's prerequisites are hedged, so this is not a false claim.","recommended_fix":"Include the materializer excerpt, or keep the doc wording at "可建立模板；送達需符合下列前提". Attach the evidence and handoff to canonical acceptance.","required_test":"A materializer-level test for each of the three LINE triggers, or an explicit statement that LINE delivery is outside the WP-19 claim.","confidence":0.5},{"severity":"NIT","area":"Form helper copy density","file":"src/components/message-template-form-client.tsx","issue":"A single info box always shows three long LINE-specific paragraphs, including when the selected channel is Email. The wording is hard to maintain and hard to read.","evidence":"The info box contains LINE binding, latest-template, queue-invalidation and five-message-limit text, unconditional on `channel`. `TemplateChannelFields` keeps the channel state inside a child component, so the parent cannot switch the copy.","impact":"The text is accurate but noisy. Future changes to LINE rules would need edits to one dense block, and Email users may be confused.","recommended_fix":"Lift the channel state, or render the LINE guidance as a conditional component. Keep the "SMS 尚未開放" statement visible for every channel.","required_test":"Render with channel=email and channel=line. Assert the SMS-unavailable sentence appears in both and that the LINE-only guidance appears only for LINE.","confidence":0.4},{"severity":"NIT","area":"Stale handoff block in research doc","file":"docs/launch/provider-decisions-research-20261016.md","issue":"The document ends with a handoff block marked `CURRENT_TASK_STATUS: IN_PROGRESS` and `NEXT_ACTION` for a decision that the same document already records as made. A reader scanning the status could take it as current.","evidence":"The "後續已決定事項" section says WP19 is EVERY8D + extra points, not implemented. The final handoff still reads "IN_PROGRESS … 依人類對 Invoice 與 SMS 建議的後續決定續辦".","impact":"The status is historical and the doc says the comparison reflects the time of the research. The risk is only that the status is misread as current.","recommended_fix":"Mark the handoff block as the earlier round's snapshot, or point to the WP-19 doc as the current source.","required_test":"None. This is a doc review item.","confidence":0.4}]}
